entries.name: Dust Bunny
entries.description: A fuzzy lint rabbit with loose threads, large ears and warm glowing eyes. Puffs itself up and scatters lint to demand attention.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: dust-bunny.
entries.signature: Signature Soft low rounded rabbit silhouette with upright ears; only lint-bodied foe.

entries.name: Coatrack Crawler
entries.description: An ornate coat stand loaded with coats, hat and umbrella; curling hooks and feet. Offers far too many coats and shuffles into the way.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: coatrack-crawler.
entries.signature: Signature Tall branching hatrack silhouette and dangling outerwear.

entries.name: Lost Luggage
entries.description: Strapped travel suitcase with tags, little feet, toothlike lid and a red fabric tongue. Rattles its lid and spits out a forgotten handkerchief; never eats visitors.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: lost-luggage.
entries.signature: Signature Compact handled rectangle with straps and feet; preserve existing mouth shapes.

entries.name: Red Carpet Runner
entries.description: Face-free red-and-gold tasselled carpet that ripples and rolls. Insists on arranging a grand entrance by rippling beneath the scene.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: red-carpet-runner.
entries.signature: Signature Long low ribbonlike floor silhouette, no head or limbs.

entries.name: Door Greeter
entries.description: A carved wooden door whose brass knocker and ornament form a face. Opens and closes with exaggerated courtesy, briefly blocking the way.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: door-greeter.
entries.signature: Signature Upright wooden slab and knocker face; not the umbrella stand in the old description.

entries.name: Hall Mirror
entries.description: A narrow freestanding antique mirror with one small reflection offset inside the glass. Its reflection waves before the visitor does, then awkwardly tries to catch up.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle glass glint; tell reflection lifts hand; action one pose leads then follows; resolve bashful tilt.
entries.signature: Signature Slender mirror with one lagging reflection; Grand Mirror is a wide divided composition.

validation.visual: Reviewed: ornate narrow wood/brass mirror, single friendly offset reflection, readable whole silhouette, no visible clipping or anatomy defects, genuine transparency. Runtime conversion uses existing build_enemy_still function without registry changes.

entries.name: Portrait Greeter
entries.description: A horizontal oval portrait of a rosy-cheeked former host, set in a squat gilt frame. Changes a painted greeting into an overformal salute while remaining inside the frame.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle blink; tell eyebrows lift; action painted hand gestures; resolve proud pose.
entries.signature: Signature Painted torso in oval frame, not a reflected whole-room glass surface.

validation.visual: Complete horizontal oval gold frame, friendly rosy-cheeked painted host. All anatomy contained in canvas; warm tactile finish. First render retained but not used because frame touched side boundaries.
validation.conversion: Lanczos source canvas to tier convention; existing build_enemy_still for isolated new WebP only; no registry update.

entries.name: Unwelcome Guest
entries.description: A tall impeccably dressed silhouette beneath a broad hat, with slightly oversized gloves and drooping luggage tag. Has waited so long that he cannot remember whom he came to visit; repeatedly presents the wrong invitation.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle coat sway; tell invitation rises; action long polite bow; resolve embarrassed shrug.
entries.signature: Signature Narrow faceless guest with paper invitation; comically awkward rather than ominous.

entries.name: The Grand Mirror
entries.description: A broad gilded three-pane floor mirror; each pane holds one fixed reflection silhouette at a different pose. Three reflections disagree over which gesture comes next, suggesting alternating distractions.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle three glints; tell center pane lights; action pose swaps across panes; resolve synchronized bow.
entries.signature: Signature Wide three-window fan and timed reflection sequence, not a larger Hall Mirror copy.

validation.visual: Three connected floor-mirror panes with three friendly reflections in distinct poses; entire feet and carved finials visible. Broad three-panel outline distinct from narrow Hall Mirror.
validation.conversion: Lanczos source canvas to tier convention; existing build_enemy_still for isolated new WebP only; no registry update.

entries.name: The Foyer Chandelier
entries.description: A low antique chandelier with a broad crown of candles and three oversized crystal drops. Swings gently to ring its own crystals as though announcing an arrival.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle chain sway; tell candles brighten; action shallow pendulum arc and crystal tinkle; resolve settle.
entries.signature: Signature Wide suspended crown, ringing crystals; no falling hazard or violent poltergeist.

validation.visual: Broad antique brass candle crown with six candles, exactly three oversized crystals and complete chain cap. No face; full silhouette visible and separate readable crystal drops.
validation.conversion: Lanczos source canvas to tier convention; existing build_enemy_still for isolated new WebP only; no registry update.

entries.name: The Butler
entries.description: Tall formal servant with gloves, towel and tray; a blue spectral flame forms his head. Insists on perfect foyer etiquette, presenting the tray, summoning a courteous flourish and blocking departures with a bow.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: butler.
entries.signature: Signature Tall blue-flame formal servant; use actual head design rather than inventing a hidden human face.

entries.name: Button Baby
entries.description: Small rag doll with button eyes, stitched mouth, purple yarn hair and a bow. Tilts its head, waves and makes an exaggerated request to be picked for play.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: button-baby.
entries.signature: Signature Upright small purple-haired rag doll, not a rocking horse.

entries.name: Patchwork Soldier
entries.description: Stitched toy soldier wearing a red hat, with a wooden sword and star shield. Marches a ceremonial patrol and performs an over-serious toy salute; no injury depiction.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: patchwork-soldier.
entries.signature: Signature Red cap, wooden toy sword and star shield; plush soldier, not tin rifleman.

entries.name: Jack in the Box
entries.description: Smiling stitched jester on a spring inside a patterned crank box. Cranks up a clearly signaled, gentle surprise and bobs to demand applause.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: jack-in-the-box.
entries.signature: Signature Square base with tall spring curve; no untelegraphed jump scare.

entries.name: Blanket Blob
entries.description: A shy large-eyed creature peeking from a crocheted purple patchwork blanket. Peeks out, hides again and nudges the blanket into a cozy shelter.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: blanket-blob.
entries.signature: Signature Small rounded crochet mound with one face; distinct from low many-footed Creeper and multiheaded Hydra.

entries.name: Crib Curtains
entries.description: Two small nursery drapes hanging from a short brass rod, patterned with tiny stitched moons. Part to reveal nobody, then close as if a bedtime show has ended.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle hem sway; tell tiebacks lift; action two cloth panels part; resolve close.
entries.signature: Signature Paired overhead drapes; no standalone shrouded body or wrapping around children.

entries.name: Porcelain Doll
entries.description: A neat old doll in a bell-shaped dress, with painted cheeks and folded hands. Quietly swaps between three polite poses while pretending to remain an ornament.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle still; tell eye glance; action masked pose swap; resolve innocent smile.
entries.signature: Signature Glossy upright ceramic figure, unlike Button Baby’s soft stitched rag body.

entries.name: Imaginary Friend
entries.description: A small translucent outline drawn in rounded crayon strokes, with one oversized waved hand. Redraws a missing feature and invents a silly rule for the next game.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle line shimmer; tell finger doodle; action single outline stroke appears; resolve erase.
entries.signature: Signature Flat colored scribble silhouette; no solid doll or fully rendered ghost child.

entries.name: The Patchwork Giant
entries.description: Bulky assemblage of stuffed toys, patches, buttons and plush faces. Attempts one enormous group hug toward its own toys and tumbles into a soft jostle.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: patchwork-giant.
entries.signature: Signature Broad plush assemblage; retain each visible stuffed face, distinct from single small ragdoll.

entries.name: The Toy Chest
entries.description: Ornate chest with expressive front eyes, plush contents and small clawlike feet. Pops open to insist everyone tidy the toys, then rearranges them incorrectly.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: toy-chest.
entries.signature: Signature Heavy eyed chest with toy contents; preserve eyes and clawlike feet, never portray biting.

entries.name: The Grand Music Box
entries.description: An ornate wide music box opening onto a miniature stage with three simple performer silhouettes. Repeats the finale until every toy has taken a bow.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle crank turn; tell lid opens; action three fixed dancers slide across stage; resolve bow and close.
entries.signature: Signature Wide opening stage with miniature chorus, not a single ballerina or flying box.

entries.name: The Governess
entries.description: Spectral Victorian governess or doll with layered dark dress, sewing props and lavender smoke. Fusses over bedtime and toy placement, arranging everything with prim gestures rather than striking.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: governess.
entries.signature: Signature Layered violet dress and sewing motif; existing supernatural caretaker identity preserved.

entries.name: Wardrobe Guest
entries.description: Narrow wardrobe opening to reveal purple eyes and a slender shadow guest. Peeks out as if trying to choose an outfit, then shyly closes the door.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: wardrobe-guest.
entries.signature: Signature Narrow single compartment and one slender guest; elite Wardrobe is broad and many-compartment.

entries.name: Rocking Chair
entries.description: An empty low wooden rocker with a padded seat and gently curved runners. Rocks itself forward to reserve a favorite spot.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle rocking; tell runner lift; action short slide; resolve rock back.
entries.signature: Signature Low curved furniture silhouette and pendulum rocking, not a broad haunted bed.

entries.name: Nightstand Poltergeist
entries.description: A compact bedside table with a pair of spectacles, one book and a tiny alarm clock. Rearranges the bedtime essentials into the least helpful order.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle drawer twitch; tell glasses lift; action three props swap; resolve drawer closes.
entries.signature: Signature Small square furniture and precise object swap, not wide writing desk or toy chest.

entries.name: Blanket Creeper
entries.description: Low patterned blanket mound with many pale clawlike feet around its hem. Shuffles along as a stubborn moving blanket fort; existing feet remain but never grab or scratch visitors.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: blanket-creeper.
entries.signature: Signature Long low hem and many feet; no single peeking face or multiple plush heads.

entries.name: Slipper Skitter
entries.description: Soft purple and pink slippers with bows, huge toe-eyes and pompomlike legs. Scurries to the wrong bedside and nervously doubles back.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: slipper-skitter.
entries.signature: Signature Paired low soft slippers with toe-eyes; frantic little scuttle instead of ballroom steps.

entries.name: Bedsheet Apparition
entries.description: A plain white bedsheet floats upright over an invisible round form, with a gently scalloped hem. Practices a very small boo, then flutters apologetically.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle bob; tell sheet puffs; action short flutter; resolve sink.
entries.signature: Signature Tall simple white sheet silhouette, no feet, crochet, lace or stuffed heads.

entries.name: Sleepwalking Ghost
entries.description: A round-faced translucent sleeper in striped nightwear and a floppy cap, eyes closed. Sleepwalks a careful half-step and snores a tiny visible cloud.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle breathing; tell cap droops; action one drowsy step; resolve sleepy sway.
entries.signature: Signature Soft humanoid nightclothes and snore motion; distinct from sheet and furniture foes.

entries.name: The Blanket Hydra
entries.description: Patchwork mound with plush rabbit, bear and dinosaurlike heads. Its heads disagree about bedtime and take turns peeking and yawning.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: blanket-hydra.
entries.signature: Signature Three different plush-head silhouettes, not a small blanket face or a low-footed fort.

entries.name: The Wardrobe
entries.description: Broad many-compartment cabinet containing glowing eyes and extending shadow arms. Presents an absurd number of outfits; hands fuss with sleeves rather than seize visitors.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: the-wardrobe.
entries.signature: Signature Wide segmented cabinet with several eye pairs and arms; not a larger single Wardrobe Guest.

entries.name: The Bedside Vigil
entries.description: Three gentle spectral caretakers gathered around a small empty cot: one with a candle, one with a folded sheet, one watching the clock. Over-coordinates a bedtime routine and keeps waking the room with courteous checks.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle shared sway; tell candle lifts; action three sequential gestures; resolve simultaneous shush.
entries.signature: Signature Fixed triangular group and tiny cot, staged as one sprite cluster; no deathbed imagery.

entries.name: The Canopy Bed
entries.description: A broad four-poster bed with rounded finials, plump cushions and a tasseled canopy. Builds a cozy stage for an impossible bedtime, politely lowering its drapes and bouncing the pillows.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle tassel sway; tell cushions rise; action two curtain panels close and mattress bobs; resolve curtains part.
entries.signature: Signature Wide four-post architecture and soft mattress bounce; does not sprout teeth, limbs or animate an entire room.

entries.name: Dough Blob
entries.description: Soft pale dough mass with huge glossy eyes and smaller dough faces. Puffs up as if overproofing, then slumps into a floury wobble.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: dough-blob.
entries.signature: Signature Pale soft dough silhouette with stretchy folds, no candy coating.

entries.name: Candy Clump
entries.description: A small sticky creature covered in colorful sweets, with large eyes and a gummy mouth. Drops and retrieves sticky sweets while trying to hold itself together.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: candy-clump.
entries.signature: Signature Small irregular multicolor candy cluster; differs from Sugar Golem’s blocky cube body.

entries.name: Jam Jar
entries.description: Red jam jar with a gingham cover, lid, tag, expressive eyes and jelly limbs. Wobbles its lid and spills a little jelly to make a sticky nuisance.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: jam-jar.
entries.signature: Signature Glass cylinder, gingham cap and red translucent limbs.

entries.name: Pantry Mimic
entries.description: Decorative floral pantry tin with a hinged toothlike lid, cloth tongue and little limbs. Rattles and pops its lid to demand refilling, never bites or swallows visitors.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: pantry-mimic.
entries.signature: Signature Upright floral tin, unlike Lost Luggage’s horizontal strapped travel case.

entries.name: Kitchen Poltergeist
entries.description: Three cooking tools hover around an empty workspace: whisk, wooden spoon and folded towel. Whisks an invisible recipe so vigorously that the towel keeps escaping.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle tools float; tell whisk lifts; action short mixing loop; resolve towel catches.
entries.signature: Signature Open triangular utensil cluster; avoid knife-point presentation or a body made of food.

entries.name: Spectral Scullion
entries.description: A small translucent kitchen servant in rolled sleeves, balancing three mismatched dishes. Insists on washing already clean dishes and rearranges the stack mid-bow.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle stack wobble; tell plate lifts; action three-plate exchange; resolve proud nod.
entries.signature: Signature Tiny staff silhouette with tall plate stack, unlike large pastry chef.

entries.name: Hanging Pots
entries.description: Three copper pots hang at uneven lengths from one short ceiling rack. Clinks an accidental kitchen rhythm while pretending nothing moved.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle sway; tell one pot tilts; action staggered short swings; resolve final tiny clink.
entries.signature: Signature Wide hanging row with hollow copper shapes; not a rolling pot or food creature.

entries.name: The Sugar Golem
entries.description: Stocky candy construct with sugar-cube fists and an icing face. Stacks and restacks its own sugar blocks in a solemn confectionery demonstration.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: sugar-golem.
entries.signature: Signature Large stepped white cube silhouette and blocky gestures, unlike sticky small Candy Clump.

entries.name: The Oven Maw
entries.description: Cast-iron oven with glowing orange grill mouth, dial eyes and short feet. Huffs a warm cloud, opens for inspection and insists the timer has not finished.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: oven-maw.
entries.signature: Signature Heavy squat iron appliance and warm grill light; preserve mouth, no engulfing animation meaning.

entries.name: The Cellar Steward
entries.description: A lantern-carrying spectral servant in waistcoat and apron, with a narrow inventory ledger. Counts bottles, discovers an extra and starts over with great dignity.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle ledger scan; tell pencil taps; action three bottle silhouettes reorder; resolve resigned nod.
entries.signature: Signature Lean ledger-bearing human silhouette and bottled inventory ritual; not another appliance.

entries.name: The Confectioner
entries.description: Elaborate spectral pastry chef with cream-and-candy hat, sweet-making props and pink magic. Conducts an elaborate dessert demonstration, dusting and decorating rather than threatening to cook or eat anyone.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: confectioner.
entries.signature: Signature Large decorated hat and pink confectionery flourish; preserves actual stylized chef instead of a new flour-only silhouette.

entries.name: Creeping Ivy
entries.description: Compact leaf-and-vine tangle with curling tendrils and warm eyes. Curling stems try to neaten the surrounding pots, then coil shyly back.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: creeping-ivy.
entries.signature: Signature Low compact eyed foliage tangle, not a hanging curtain or animal topiary.

entries.name: Walking Planter
entries.description: A broad round ceramic planter glides on a skirt of exposed decorative roots. Repositions itself to steal the best patch of light.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle leaves nod; tell roots lift; action short scoot; resolve satisfied settle.
entries.signature: Signature Large smooth ceramic belly and short root skirt, distinct from loose leafy Ivy.

entries.name: Garden Shears
entries.description: Oversized brass-handled pruning shears hover with a loop of ribbon caught at one handle. Trims a stray ribbon with exaggerated precision, never aims its blades at a character.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle suspended bob; tell handles spread; action one snip away from visitor; resolve close.
entries.signature: Signature Open crossed-tool silhouette and one clear pivot; no lunging blades.

entries.name: Topiary Hound
entries.description: A carefully clipped green hedge shaped like a short-legged dog, with a squared muzzle and leafy tail. Stands a formal garden guard, then politely offers a clipped-leaf paw.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle tail shake; tell head tilt; action paw lift; resolve stiff sit.
entries.signature: Signature Low blocky canine outline and trained paw gesture; no hunting or biting.

entries.name: Topiary Hare
entries.description: An elegant narrow rabbit-shaped shrub with two exceptionally tall ears. Darts one hop, then freezes as a flawless garden ornament.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle ear twitch; tell crouch; action single small hop; resolve freeze.
entries.signature: Signature Tall ears and compact springing body, distinct from horizontal hound.

entries.name: Garden Statue
entries.description: A small rounded stone gardener holding a watering can, with a broad hat and cheerful face. Changes its watering pose when attention shifts, as if practicing for a portrait.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle still; tell hat tilts; action two fixed pose swap; resolve innocent look.
entries.signature: Signature Upright worker statue with watering can; not the graveyard’s crouched gargoyle.

entries.name: Fountain Spirit
entries.description: A small translucent water figure rising above a low scalloped basin, with a rounded head and flowing sleeve. Pours an impossible cup of water and lets it flow upward instead.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle rippling base; tell silhouette gathers; action one curved ribbon rises; resolve collapse to basin.
entries.signature: Signature Single fluid figure with one water ribbon; elite fountain uses architectural tiers instead.

entries.name: The Compost Colossus
entries.description: Bulky mulch humanoid with a root beard, mushrooms, pots and garden tools. Shakes loose a harmless shower of leaves while proudly tending its own sprouting shoulders.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: compost-colossus.
entries.signature: Signature Heavy earthy block silhouette with root beard and pottery; no decay gore.

entries.name: The Ancient Topiary
entries.description: An ornate sculpted foliage beast with curls, branches, flowers and glowing eyes. Holds a grand ceremonial pose, then rustles its elaborate curls to show off.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: ancient-topiary.
entries.signature: Signature Broad ornate fixed foliage beast; preserve actual form, no costly stag-to-bear-to-horse morphing.

entries.name: The Midnight Fountain
entries.description: A three-tier decorative fountain with climbing leaves and a small stone bird on its rim. Reverses its flow and politely rearranges the reflected moon into the wrong basin.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle tier glimmer; tell top bowl lights; action three short upward-water ribbon loops; resolve tiny ripple.
entries.signature: Signature Tiered architectural column with repeating upward ribbons; no extra spirit humanoids or moving statue crowd.

entries.name: The Carnivorous Conservatory
entries.description: A walking glass greenhouse with root feet, a central toothy mouth and flytrap blooms. Huffs humid air, rattles its panes and fusses over its plants. Despite the retained name and teeth, it never eats, hunts or encloses visitors.
entries.animation: 2D animation Reuse existing clips unchanged. Asset ID: carnivorous-conservatory.
entries.signature: Signature Wide glasshouse silhouette with root feet and flower mouths; existing art and clips remain mandatory.

entries.name: Headstone Walker
entries.description: A weathered gravestone sliding or hopping slowly across the ground while dirt shifts beneath it. Politely nudges its own plot marker into the visitor’s path, suggesting a brief obstruction.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle lean; tell dirt puff; action short hop; resolve settle.
entries.signature: Signature Low broad stone silhouette; moves its marker, not its engraved occupant.

entries.name: Epitaph Spirit
entries.description: Pale ghost emerging directly from engraved writing on a tombstone, with letters still floating through its body. Spells a remembered name in floating letters, briefly distracting attention.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle letter drift; tell two glyphs glow; action ghost rises; resolve letters settle.
entries.signature: Signature Narrow typographic apparition; the lettering, not a walking stone, is its body.

entries.name: Mourning Candle
entries.description: Tall black funeral candle drifting above the ground with wax flowing upward and a blue spectral flame. Patiently relights itself whenever the evening becomes too quiet.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle flame loop; tell wick dip; action wax curls upward; resolve small glow.
entries.signature: Signature Single thin candle with reverse wax motion, not an architectural light fixture.

entries.name: Funeral Veil
entries.description: Long black mourning veil floating as if worn by an invisible figure, occasionally forming the outline of a head and shoulders. Practices an excessively formal bow, brushing a soft curtain of lace across the encounter.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle hem sway; tell bow; action lace fan; resolve upright.
entries.signature: Signature Broad triangular lace silhouette; never constricts or resembles a wrapped body.

entries.name: Gargoyle
entries.description: Small cemetery statue that changes posture whenever nobody is watching it directly. A squat stone ornament pretends it has not moved, then cheekily changes its perch.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle still; tell blink; action two-pose shuffle; resolve frozen grin.
entries.signature: Signature Compact crouched statue and sheepish freeze, unlike the greenhouse’s upright gardener.

entries.name: Memorial Wreath
entries.description: A low circular wreath of faded silk flowers with an oversized remembrance ribbon. Re-ties its bow until it covers its own dedication, suggesting a brief concealment nuisance.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle petal twitch; tell ribbon loops rise; action bow ties; resolve satisfied bounce.
entries.signature: Signature Hollow floral ring with bow action, no stone body or mournful humanoid.

entries.name: Sandglass Sexton
entries.description: A squat hourglass in a dark wooden cradle; pale sand flows upward. Counts down the wrong way to prolong a respectful moment of silence.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle sand loop; tell frame tilts; action half-turn; resolve gentle settle.
entries.signature: Signature Transparent waist and moving sand; no clock hands or skeletal anatomy.

entries.name: The Mourning Angel
entries.description: Large weathered angel ornament, round-faced and solemn, with folded stone wings. Opens its wings to shelter smaller apparitions, suggesting a temporary protective stance.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle still; tell head inclines; action two wing panels unfold; resolve stone shrug.
entries.signature: Signature Wide upper-body fan with slow protection gestures; not a jumping gargoyle.

entries.name: The Mausoleum
entries.description: Compact ornate tomb facade with one open doorway and warm lights receding inside. Invites everyone to take the very long scenic route indoors.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle candle flicker; tell door cracks; action three-layer interior parallax; resolve close.
entries.signature: Signature Heavy building facade; depth is a fixed three-plane illusion, not a simulated cemetery.

entries.name: The Cemetery Gate
entries.description: Two wrought-iron leaves on squat stone posts, with an oversized swinging padlock. Closes for the evening far too early and politely holds the line.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle lock swing; tell latch lifts; action gate leaves pivot; resolve reopen.
entries.signature: Signature Open ironwork barrier; no grasping hands, chains around people, or angry face.

entries.name: The Widow of the Grounds
entries.description: A dignified spectral mourner in black formal dress; a broad veiled hat softens her silhouette. Hosts a quiet remembrance that keeps restarting whenever a flower is out of place. She lights candles and gathers gentle rain, never strikes or pursues.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle veil sway; tell flower lift; action three candle glows or small rain overlay; resolve grateful bow.
entries.signature: Signature Single flowing mourner with floral and rain motifs; sorrowful but not frightening.

entries.name: Rolling Ladder
entries.description: Large wooden library ladder racing along brass rails under invisible control, stopping and changing direction abruptly. Insists on reshelving the visitor, rolling across the usable space.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle rung creak; tell wheel pivot; action short rail slide; resolve brake.
entries.signature: Signature Tall open diagonal lattice; strong lateral movement.

entries.name: Loose Pages
entries.description: Three oversized old pages orbit an unseen center, each bearing one fixed line of faint writing; they align into a fussy correction without morphing into new silhouettes. Rearranges a sentence into a fussy correction, suggesting a temporary nuisance.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle three-page orbit; tell pages align; action fan out; resolve orbit.
entries.signature: Signature Flat pale paper fan, not closed books or liquid ink.

entries.name: Studying Ghost
entries.description: Deep leather reading chair that glides through the room while a ghost reader sitting on it turns pages. Raises a finger for quiet, then goes back to a book held upside down.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle page turn; tell glasses lift; action shush; resolve embarrassed page flip.
entries.signature: Signature Seated reader integrated with low chair, unlike standing staff.

entries.name: Globe
entries.description: Antique globe spinning by itself while continents shift position and tiny lights move across its surface. Spins the wrong continent forward and proposes a detour.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle slow spin; tell meridian tilt; action map layer shifts; resolve click.
entries.signature: Signature Round sphere in crescent support; one rotating map layer.

entries.name: Bookmark Ribbon
entries.description: One wide silk bookmark floats like a streamer, curling into a neat loop beside a book without wrapping around arbitrary scenery. Marks the wrong place with a neat ribbon loop, suggesting a delayed action.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle tip sway; tell curl; action one loop flick using fixed ribbon poses; resolve untie.
entries.signature: Signature Single flat ribbon with a tasselled tip and one loop gesture, not a large cloth body.

entries.name: Writing Desk
entries.description: Large desk whose drawers, blotter, papers, ink bottles, and correspondence all move under a single unseen presence. Reorders its correspondence into an unhelpfully perfect queue.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle pen bob; tell drawer opens; action three envelopes exchange; resolve drawer shuts.
entries.signature: Signature Low horizontal furniture; stationery sorting instead of catalogue storage.

entries.name: Library Clock
entries.description: Tall clock whose hands reverse, accelerate, and stop while its chimes cause nearby books to react. Demands one more minute of quiet reading and repeats its chime.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle pendulum; tell hand pauses; action hand steps backward; resolve chime wobble.
entries.signature: Signature Tall narrow pendulum clock; domestic minutes rather than celestial cycles.

entries.name: The Living Index
entries.description: A broad catalogue cabinet with staggered drawers and cream index cards. Files every visitor under the wrong heading, repeatedly changing its order.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle label twitch; tell one drawer opens; action three drawer/card pairs cycle; resolve drawers settle.
entries.signature: Signature Wide grid geometry with mechanical filing waves, not a single writing desk.

entries.name: The Atlas Room
entries.description: Oversized open atlas on an angled stand, with two map spreads visible. Offers an impressive detour on a page that folds back to the starting point.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle page edge lift; tell map glows; action page wipe to one alternate flat vista; resolve shut halfway.
entries.signature: Signature Broad open-book silhouette and folded geography; no objects physically travel into a fully built scene.

entries.name: The Black Ink Manuscript
entries.description: A narrow handwritten book on a tall lectern, with one hovering ink ribbon. Corrects the visitor’s intentions with a pompous flourish, suggesting a one-turn instruction nuisance.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle nib trace; tell line gathers; action calligraphy curl; resolve blot dries.
entries.signature: Signature Tall lectern and liquid line; unlike the Atlas’s broad map window and loose-page fan.

entries.name: The Head Librarian
entries.description: A compact spectral librarian with round spectacles, a ledger and neatly arranged sleeves. Shushes, checks the catalogue and directs books into perfect order. Their sternness becomes comic when a single page refuses to stay put.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle ledger glance; tell raised finger; action three book silhouettes return to a small shelf strip; resolve spectacles slip.
entries.signature: Signature Seated-height, compact authority and precise finger gestures; scenery represented by a short shelf strip.

entries.name: Telescope Eye
entries.description: Antique brass telescope that turns and tracks the player by itself, with a faint blinking reflection deep inside the lens. Peers too closely, placing a conspicuous observing glint on its chosen subject.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle tube sway; tell lens gleam; action gentle extend; resolve retract.
entries.signature: Signature Long horizontal brass tube, not a freestanding mirror.

entries.name: Astrolabe
entries.description: Brass astronomical instrument spinning under invisible control while its rings align into impossible patterns. Aligns its rings to announce a comically inaccurate prediction.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle ring rock; tell pointers align; action rings rotate; resolve soft click.
entries.signature: Signature Open circular brass rings; no sphere or planet collection.

entries.name: Tripod Camera
entries.description: Old box camera on wooden legs that repositions itself and flashes without anyone operating it. Requests a portrait, then refuses to stop counting down.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle bellows breathe; tell shutter lifts; action soft flash overlay; resolve little print.
entries.signature: Signature Three-legged box silhouette; no startling flash or rapid strobe.

entries.name: Attic Trunk
entries.description: Large travel trunk sliding across the floor while its lid opens to reveal changing contents or impossible darkness. Reveals an absurdly small forgotten memento rather than its expected contents.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle lid wobble; tell clasp opens; action lid rises and one object floats; resolve close.
entries.signature: Signature Wide floor chest with three fixed memento swaps; no teeth or creature inside.

entries.name: Spectral Assistant
entries.description: Faint translucent observatory attendant carrying charts, lenses, and notebooks while mostly ignoring the player. Consults an upside-down chart and mislabels the visitor as a constellation.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle chart scan; tell point; action stamp gesture; resolve puzzled head tilt.
entries.signature: Signature Small chart-bearing assistant, not a commanding elite or boss.

entries.name: Moonbeam Figure
entries.description: Human silhouette visible only inside a column of moonlight, disappearing whenever it leaves the beam. Attempts to follow the visitor but can move only inside its own light.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle translucent sway; tell beam narrows; action sideways lean; resolve re-center.
entries.signature: Signature One pale silhouette confined to a vertical beam, no extra independent figures.

entries.name: Contrary Weather Vane
entries.description: A brass rooster and arrow balanced on a short roof finial, with N and S tags. Points confidently toward the wrong direction, then spins to correct itself too late.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle arrow tremble; tell rooster leans; action quarter-turn plate swap; resolve wobble.
entries.signature: Signature Crossed directional silhouette; angular swiveling rather than lens tracking or clock time.

entries.name: The Moon Lens
entries.description: Huge round lens in a suspended horseshoe-shaped brass frame; pale reflected clouds cross the glass. Magnifies one harmless detail until it becomes an enormous distraction.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle suspended sway; tell lens cloud clears; action soft magnified overlay; resolve blur.
entries.signature: Signature One clear circular disc; unlike the telescope’s narrow tube, its action is magnification.

entries.name: The Celestial Clock
entries.description: A broad astronomical clock with three oversized moon-phase discs and short brass hands. Announces the wrong night and makes its moon discs disagree.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle disc tick; tell all hands align; action discs step out of sync; resolve chime.
entries.signature: Signature Wide multi-disc face and lunar phase puzzle; not the library’s tall pendulum clock.

entries.name: The Suspended Planetarium
entries.description: A low domed brass projector with star-shaped cutouts and one crescent shutter. Projects drifting star shapes over useful room markings, mischievously obscuring them until its crescent shutter closes.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle dotted glow; tell shutter lifts; action fixed star overlay drifts; resolve shutter lowers.
entries.signature: Signature Low dome silhouette and star projection, not another ring instrument or lens.

entries.name: The Watcher in the Rafters
entries.description: An enormous soft-edged shadow tucked along a short rafter arch, with two round curious eyes and long folded shadow limbs. Peeks from different openings as though hoping not to disturb anyone, shifting attention with telescopes and moonlight rather than lunging.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle eye blink; tell eyes glance toward next opening; action masked shadow slide between three fixed sockets; resolve bashful retreat.
entries.signature: Signature Wide overhead rafter silhouette; limbs behave like loose shadows, never spider fangs or predatory legs.

entries.name: Wall Sconce
entries.description: Antique wall lamp that floats free from the wall while its flame bends toward targets. Swivels its pool of light to make the wrong thing look important.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle flame bend; tell bracket swivel; action warm spotlight sweep; resolve straighten.
entries.signature: Signature Bracket-mounted side silhouette; one local beam rather than roomwide switching.

entries.name: Gaslight Ghost
entries.description: Tall translucent figure visible only inside the glow of old gas lamps, fading whenever the light dims. Appears briefly to admire its reflection in the lamp glow, then forgets why it came.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle glow pulse; tell silhouette gathers; action dignified gesture; resolve fade.
entries.signature: Signature Soft figure made visible by a fixed nearby glow, not soot marks or empty clothing.

entries.name: Lantern Bearer
entries.description: Empty old coat and gloved hands carrying a floating lantern, with no visible person inside the clothing. Offers a politely misleading route by lifting its lantern in the wrong direction.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle coat sway; tell lantern lift; action point; resolve apologetic shrug.
entries.signature: Signature Empty coat with solid gloves and a handheld lamp; body and light remain distinct.

entries.name: Fuse Box
entries.description: Old electrical cabinet whose switches flip, wires twitch, and sparks jump between open contacts. Flips its switches in a mischievous sequence, suggesting a short interruption.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle meter twitch; tell latch opens; action two switches flip; resolve indicator glow.
entries.signature: Signature Small rectangular electrical cabinet, not the elite’s broad control console.

entries.name: Gas Valve
entries.description: A brass pipe valve turns itself and releases one soft question-mark puff of ghostly vapor; no changing faces or hands. Puffs a tiny question-mark cloud and then whistles to itself.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle pointer wobble; tell wheel quarter-turn; action one question-mark steam sprite expands and fades; resolve rewind.
entries.signature: Signature Compact brass wheel and elbow pipe; no flame bursts toward the player.

entries.name: Soot Shadow
entries.description: Humanlike silhouette made from smoke and soot, visible mainly where it stains nearby walls. Leaves an exaggerated charcoal silhouette where the visitor was standing.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle edge drift; tell hand sketch; action stain stencil appears; resolve dust puff.
entries.signature: Signature Flat matte wall mark, distinguished from translucent luminous ghosts.

entries.name: Light Switch Shadow
entries.description: A shadowy hand repeatedly appearing beside wall switches before vanishing into the plaster. Sneaks in to flick one switch, then withdraws before being blamed.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle switch plate; tell shadow fingertip; action flick; resolve hand retract.
entries.signature: Signature Tiny wall plate and hand silhouette, not a free-moving humanoid.

entries.name: The Main Switchboard
entries.description: Broad wall console with three large levers, two meters and an ordered line of indicator bulbs. Conducts an overcomplicated lights-on inspection, briefly prioritizing one circuit over another.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle meter bob; tell selected bulb glows; action lever flips and three indicators chase; resolve click.
entries.signature: Signature Wide electrical control surface; differs from the small Fuse Box through ordered circuits, not merely scale.

entries.name: The Gas Manifold
entries.description: Low broad brass pipe manifold with three valves, glass reservoirs and one central gauge. Puffs a dignified steam fan while insisting every old lamp is perfectly serviced.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle gauge rock; tell valves turn; action three soft vapor puffs; resolve gauges settle.
entries.signature: Signature Horizontal pipework with timed pressure puffs, not electrical switching.

entries.name: The Glassworks Rack
entries.description: Tall tilted frame holding three large lamp-glass shapes: globe, chimney and fluted shade. Rearranges its glassware into a prismatic distraction, then carefully shelves it again.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle tiny glass sway; tell three pieces lift; action fan into fixed arc; resolve return.
entries.signature: Signature Triangular rack and clear hanging glass; use three props, not an expensive particle cloud.

entries.name: The Lamplighter
entries.description: A spectral maintenance worker in a long soft coat and cap, carrying an old lighting pole. Performs one last round of lighting every lamp, then notices one behind him has gone out. His pole is a service tool, never a spear.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle coat sway; tell pole rises; action three lamp halos ignite in sequence; resolve shadow catches up.
entries.signature: Signature Tall diagonal lighting pole and following shadow; patient maintenance ritual rather than hostile wielding.

entries.name: Masquerade Mask
entries.description: Floating ornate ballroom mask with trailing ribbons and a crisp side profile. Coyly hides behind its own ribbon before peeking from the wrong side.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle ribbon sway; tell tilt; action side peek; resolve stately float.
entries.signature: Signature Single narrow half-mask with trailing ribbon, not the elite’s feathered full face.

entries.name: Waltzing Shoes
entries.description: A pair of elegant formal shoes dancing by themselves in synchronized side stepping motions. Continues a dance step after the music stops, suggesting a rhythmic nuisance.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle heel tap; tell toe lift; action three-step shuffle; resolve polite heel click.
entries.signature: Signature Two glossy pointed shoes; upright formal dance, not scuttling bedroom slippers.

entries.name: Candelabra
entries.description: Tall brass candelabra gliding across the floor with blue flames bending and flaring as it moves. Bows its branches and makes its flames dance in a formal sequence, insisting everyone match the party rhythm.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle flame sway; tell branches bow; action three flames dip in sequence; resolve proud straighten.
entries.signature: Signature Wide branching brass stand, contrasting the graveyard’s single slender candle.

entries.name: Serving Tray
entries.description: Floating silver tray carrying glasses and covered dishes, tilted by unseen hands. Offers an empty glass with elaborate courtesy and expects a thank-you.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle level float; tell cloche lifts; action tray tilts; resolve graceful retreat.
entries.signature: Signature Flat silver oval with one dome and glass; not kitchen orbiting tools.

entries.name: Ghost Guest
entries.description: Refined translucent party guest in old formalwear, drifting with a drink in hand. Tries to tell the same anecdote again, pausing for a laugh that never comes.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle goblet swirl; tell raised finger; action small speech puff; resolve bemused bow.
entries.signature: Signature Short round party guest, not imposing host or tall shadow silhouette.

entries.name: Violin Poltergeist
entries.description: Violin and bow moving together under invisible control in quick musical gestures. Plays one melodramatic wrong note to interrupt the room.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle bow hover; tell bow draws back; action short bow stroke; resolve string wobble.
entries.signature: Signature Asymmetric violin and diagonal bow, with no visible performer.

entries.name: Top Hat Shade
entries.description: A neat shadow figure defined mostly by a top hat, shoulders, and gloved hands. Tips its hat but briefly leaves its shadow behind.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle hat bob; tell tip; action silhouette offset; resolve reunite.
entries.signature: Signature Compact hat-and-shoulder cutout; exaggerated politeness rather than looming menace.

entries.name: The Grand Masque
entries.description: A broad full-face festival mask with an oversized crescent of feathers and layered jewel drops. Performs three grand expressions in a rigid ceremonial order, making the room follow its mood.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle plume bounce; tell center jewel glows; action fixed expression plate changes and feather fan; resolve curtain-like ribbons settle.
entries.signature: Signature Wide feather fan and formal expression sequence, unlike regular half-mask’s shy lateral peeks.

entries.name: The Eternal Dance
entries.description: Two translucent ballroom dancers joined in one clear crescent pose, one coat and one bell-shaped skirt. Carries on the same elegant waltz, inviting everyone to keep its measured rhythm.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle shared sway; tell held bow; action short three-step side loop; resolve pause together.
entries.signature: Signature Paired connected figures; no full spin, rear view or independent crowd animation.

entries.name: The Velvet Host
entries.description: A round-shouldered faceless figure in rich velvet, balancing a tall goblet and folded napkin. Offers impeccable hospitality in the wrong order and repeatedly asks everyone to remain seated.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle sleeve sway; tell napkin unfolds; action trayless presentation gesture; resolve satisfied bow.
entries.signature: Signature Broad velvet torso and goblet silhouette; formal service, not the boss’s conducting.

entries.name: The Master of Revels
entries.description: A supernatural host in burgundy formalwear with high collar, long sash and short conductor’s baton; a smiling porcelain-like half-face. Conducts the party’s last dance, then enthusiastically calls for an encore. Every gesture is showmanship rather than a threat.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle baton count; tell deep bow; action three broad conducting poses with ribbon follow-through; resolve delighted applause.
entries.signature: Signature Crimson vertical conductor silhouette, contrasting the elite Host’s broad velvet service pose.

entries.name: Floating Coffin
entries.description: One upright hexagonal coffin lid, plum lacquer, brass handles and a softly glowing seam; never a mouth. A fussy usher, it politely blocks the wrong aisle. Intent idea: brief protection.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: hover. Tell: handles lift. Action: pivot broadside, trace a pale shield. Resolve: handles bow.
entries.signature: Signature A single solid shield silhouette; no coffin occupant, portal or wheeled furniture.

entries.name: Funeral Urn
entries.description: A squat lilac memorial urn with curled handles and an oversized, slightly crooked lid. An interrupted snoozer puffs out one annoyed spectral sigh, then tucks it back inside. Intent idea: weaken an upcoming effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: lid trembles. Tell: lid tilts. Action: emit one curling puff. Resolve: puff retracts; lid settles.
entries.signature: Signature Round, closed vessel; no emerging humanoid, face or boiling food.

entries.name: Bone Chimes
entries.description: Five clean, rounded, stylized ivory bones suspended from a small crescent bracket; no skull, flesh or anatomical assembly. They insist on finishing their tiny bedtime tune. One bone rings before being touched. Intent idea: a delayed repeat.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: gentle sway. Tell: one bone glows. Action: sequential clacks and note dots. Resolve: strings straighten.
entries.signature: Signature Small hanging comb silhouette, dominated by sound rather than a skeletal creature.

entries.name: Mourning Fan
entries.description: An open, pearl-edged black pleated fan, hovering upright with a short ivory handle. An invisible mourner fans away sighs with exaggerated disapproval; its breeze blows its own tassel the wrong way. Intent idea: soften a strong effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: slow tilt. Tell: folds compress. Action: two brisk sweeps, crescent draft. Resolve: snap elegantly open.
entries.signature: Signature Broad crescent with rigid folding ribs, not another floating veil or shroud.

entries.name: Censer Swinger
entries.description: A pierced bronze incense sphere hanging beneath a triangular chain yoke, violet light visible through its holes. It perfumes visitors who never asked, leaving one neat smoke ring hanging sideways. Intent idea: obscure the next intent briefly.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: pendulum sway. Tell: holes brighten. Action: short swing and ring puff. Resolve: ring shrinks into sphere.
entries.signature: Signature Compact metal pendulum; fragrance, not flame or a vapor person, supplies its personality.

entries.name: Mortuary Measure
entries.description: An ivory folding measuring rule bent into a crooked zigzag, with tiny brass joint caps. An unseen tailor measures everyone's patience, extending beyond its own last mark. Intent idea: prepare a larger next effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: joint taps. Tell: markings glow. Action: unfold three segments; luminous extra mark appears. Resolve: concertina shut.
entries.signature: Signature Angular articulated ruler; no arm, crawling anatomy, weapon or humanoid body.

entries.name: Bier Trestle
entries.description: A low violet-padded wooden trestle, two broad folding supports and brass corner caps; nothing rests on it. It keeps offering a seat, then politely forgetting how tall seats are. Intent idea: alternate a sturdy and vulnerable stance.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: cushion dimples. Tell: hinges glow. Action: supports fold; cushion floats unchanged. Resolve: legs unfold beneath it.
entries.signature: Signature Low geometric support and impossible stationary cushion, not a bed, chair or coffin cart.

entries.name: The Coffin Bearers
entries.description: Two short translucent porters share one shallow, closed ceremonial casket. Broad capelets and mismatched tall hats make a single low, horizontal sprite group. They keep courteously disagreeing over which end should lead; the casket continues level while both bow. Intent idea: alternating support and interruption.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: synchronized bob. Tell: hats tip opposite ways. Action: casket glides one body-width as porters briefly lag behind. Resolve: both catch up and bow. Keep the casket rigid.
entries.signature: Signature A comic two-person carrying ritual, not another moving lid or coffin full of surprises.

entries.name: The Epitaph Press
entries.description: A squat cast-iron embossing press with a broad open throat, oversized hooked lever and one small stack of blank memorial ribbons. The overparticular machine labels every visitor 'PLEASE WAIT'; the lettering lifts away before the ribbon leaves the bed. Intent idea: apply a brief delay.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: lever gives tiny impatient ticks. Tell: platen lights violet. Action: one downward stamp releases a single floating label. Resolve: ribbon slides back; lever rises. Use one label effect.
entries.signature: Signature Heavy lever-and-platen silhouette; not a cabinet, writing desk, barrel press or autonomous pile of paper.

entries.name: The Mourning Standard
entries.description: A broad, diamond-ended black processional banner hangs from a rigid bronze crossbar and spearless pole. A silver border frames two embroidered shoeprints. It solemnly rehearses a procession nobody attends; the prints march upward through the fabric and reappear at its hem. Intent idea: several small delayed pulses.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tassels sway. Tell: silver border glows. Action: two footprint sprites climb on a masked loop. Resolve: prints return to their original stitched positions. Pole and banner remain rigid.
entries.signature: Signature A ceremonial heraldic object with animated embroidery, not a floating shroud, human outline or visible crowd.

entries.name: The Undertaker
entries.description: A tall translucent funeral director: bent stovepipe hat, round spectacles, swallowtail coat and oversized white gloves. A measuring ribbon hangs like a watch chain; violet light outlines his kindly, distracted profile. He mistakes visitors for guests awaiting a perfectly organized rest and gently insists they take a number. Intent idea: alternate protection and postponement.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: inspect cuffs. Tell: raise a numbered token. Action: spread hands; three violet markers align into a barrier. Resolve: markers bow and fade; he checks an empty pocket. One rig and three identical markers; no room-wide furniture sequence.
entries.signature: Signature His stoop, bent hat and fussy poses distinguish him from lantern-and-key servants and the Butler.

entries.name: Wrong-Way Sign
entries.description: A forked wooden signpost with three unequal arrow boards and a single faded lilac trail ribbon. It confidently gives contradictory directions; its shadow points somewhere none of its arrows do. Intent idea: misdirect a planned effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: ribbon twitch. Tell: shadow arrow glows. Action: boards pivot one at a time. Resolve: shadow smugly turns last.
entries.signature: Signature Asymmetrical branching silhouette and independent shadow, not a garden gate or carved statue.

entries.name: Boundary Rope
entries.description: Two squat white stone boundary posts supporting one thick, moss-green garden cord in a broad U. An invisible steward insists visitors walk around a boundary that politely sags upward. Intent idea: briefly obstruct an approach.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: cord bobs. Tell: post caps glow. Action: U reverses into an arch. Resolve: impossible arch droops normally.
entries.signature: Signature Paired low posts with one broad curve; not a barred gate, moving vine or whipping leash.

entries.name: Lawn Roller
entries.description: A heavy striped iron lawn roller under a long bent push handle, a single brown leaf stuck to its drum. It smooths an imaginary path; the leaf remains motionless while the drum turns beneath it. Intent idea: build steady protection.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: handle wags. Tell: stripe glows. Action: roll briefly; a flat spectral strip unfurls. Resolve: strip curls back inside.
entries.signature: Signature One low cylinder and a tall diagonal handle; no cart load or walking plant.

entries.name: Chalk-Line Reel
entries.description: A squat triangular gardener's reel, brass winding knob and short bright blue chalk cord. It redraws boundaries just as visitors understand them; the loose cord holds a perfect unsupported right angle. Intent idea: change a simple restriction.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: knob ticks backward. Tell: cord brightens. Action: extend a small luminous corner. Resolve: corner reels into housing.
entries.signature: Signature Compact spool plus angular local line; not writing, a map page or animated root.

entries.name: Corner Hedge
entries.description: One waist-high, squared brown hedge corner on a small soil island; clipped branches make a clear blocky L. It sulks when bypassed, turning its missing corner the other way while its shadow refuses to follow. Intent idea: switch between two defensive positions.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: two leaves tremble. Tell: corner glows. Action: crossfade two quarter-turn poses. Resolve: delayed shadow catches up.
entries.signature: Signature Geometric maze segment, never an animal topiary or thorn creature.

entries.name: Whispering Wind Sock
entries.description: A faded green conical fabric wind sock on a crooked forked pole, its narrow tail tied in a little bow. It whispers a helpful shortcut, but inflates toward the wind instead of away. Intent idea: foreshadow a misleading repeat.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tail droops. Tell: pale breath gathers. Action: cone inflates backward and gives one soft puff. Resolve: collapses with a nod.
entries.signature: Signature Long tapering horizontal cone, unlike curtains, ribbon swarms or human-shaped cloth.

entries.name: Boot Scraper
entries.description: A low cast-iron estate boot scraper with two broad bristle brushes flanking an ornate central blade; rounded edges, no cutting action. It scrubs away a spectral footprint that keeps politely reappearing. Intent idea: remove one small benefit.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: bristles shiver. Tell: footprint gleams above it. Action: brushes tilt inward and erase print. Resolve: print returns faintly.
entries.signature: Signature Small wide comb silhouette; the footprint is a local effect, not a separate invisible walker.

entries.name: The Rotting Gazebo
entries.description: A compact, lopsided octagonal gazebo with a green patinated roof, four visible posts and one empty suspended swing seat. Moss and dry leaves soften the abandoned structure. Its unseen host offers a break that somehow never begins: the seat swings forward while its shadow swings backward. Intent idea: shelter fellow haunts, then lose that protection while resetting.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: roof finial trembles. Tell: seat pauses unnaturally high. Action: one broad swing, opposing oval shadow. Resolve: seat centers; two leaves drift down. Keep roof and posts fixed.
entries.signature: Signature An open roofed shelter with pendulum seating, not a fountain, portal, cabinet or miniature inhabited house.

entries.name: The Croquet Umpire
entries.description: A tall freestanding croquet scoreboard with a stepped crown, chunky wooden number drums and two crossed mallets fixed beneath it. No face or body is attached. It declares every route out of bounds, then secretly changes its own score. Two tiny ghostly applause marks appear whenever it cheats. Intent idea: a predictable count followed by a penalty.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: one drum twitches. Tell: drums align. Action: three drums flip sequentially; a small striped ball rolls through its empty base. Resolve: the first drum quietly changes again. Use one ball sprite.
entries.signature: Signature Vertical sporting score apparatus; no nursery toy creature or repeatedly animated croquet set.

entries.name: The Lost Compass
entries.description: An oversized open pocket compass resting on its rim, a broad oval lid behind a round brass bowl and a long blue needle hovering just above it. It takes pride in helping travelers, though its needle points inward at itself and its shadow points away. Intent idea: announce one intent, then visibly switch to a different one.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: shallow rocking. Tell: needle stands upright. Action: needle pivots outside the bowl and draws one short hooked direction trail. Resolve: trail retracts; needle returns. No landscape changes.
entries.signature: Signature Open oval-and-circle profile; directions, never time, moon phases, astronomy or a changing atlas scene.

entries.name: The Gardener of Rot
entries.description: A spectral estate gardener with a drooping broad hat, patched coat and wooden clogs fading into dry leaves. A mushroom grows from his hatband, never his skin. His blunt planting dibber points downward. Fond of the old maze, he repairs the wrong paths and composts yesterday’s directions. Intent idea: preparation becomes renewal, with a readable interruption opportunity.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: inspect a dry leaf. Tell: leaf glows green. Action: raise one palm; three leaves circle and become fresh leaf shapes. Resolve: they fade brown and settle. One rig, paired leaf sprites and local glow; no transforming garden.
entries.signature: Signature A wistful, muddled gardener, without decay wounds, aggressive tools, body vines or topiary transformations.

entries.name: Peephole Watcher
entries.description: A small brass peephole set in a narrow diamond of paneled wood, its sliding cover shaped like a drooping eyelid. An unseen snoop checks whether anyone noticed it; the reflected glint looks away before the cover closes. Intent idea: reveal an upcoming choice.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: cover quivers. Tell: glint brightens. Action: cover slides; glint darts sideways. Resolve: embarrassed snap shut.
entries.signature: Signature Tiny aperture and cover, not a fleshy eye, mirror or telescope.

entries.name: Servant Bell
entries.description: One brass bell on a curled steel spring, mounted above a single blank enamel plaque with a taut wire rising behind it. It summons a servant who never arrives; its ringing shadow continues after the metal stops. Intent idea: call a small support effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: wire twitches. Tell: spring tightens. Action: bell rings twice. Resolve: metal stills; shadow rings once more.
entries.signature: Signature A single spring-bell silhouette, not a multi-bell control panel or musical instrument swarm.

entries.name: Floor Hatch
entries.description: A shallow square trapdoor in a short brass-edged floor frame, with an enormous flat iron ring handle. It plays peekaboo with a darkness that remains visible when the lid closes. Intent idea: briefly hide a small effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: ring lifts. Tell: edge glows. Action: lid rises; one round shadow peeks over lip. Resolve: lid shuts; shadow slides beneath frame.
entries.signature: Signature Low horizontal hinged geometry; no hallway vista, creature mouth or upright door.

entries.name: Listening Tube
entries.description: A slender S-curved brass speaking tube with a flared ear-shaped funnel above and a smaller downward horn below. It repeats a confidential whisper from the wrong end; a tiny light travels backward through its metal. Intent idea: echo one weak effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: funnel tilts. Tell: small horn glows. Action: backward light ripple; one comma-shaped whisper puff. Resolve: funnel shushes itself downward.
entries.signature: Signature Open curved tube, no mouth apparition, pipe swarm or steam-driven gauge.

entries.name: Loose Brick
entries.description: A single oversized red brick hovering in a rough square of old cream mortar, with three chalky white fingerprints on one edge. It taps out a secret knock, then pretends it never moved. Its mortar outline stays suspended when it leaves. Intent idea: a small delayed surprise.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: dust trembles. Tell: fingerprints brighten. Action: brick slides forward, taps twice. Resolve: retreats slightly off-center.
entries.signature: Signature Blunt horizontal masonry block and empty outline; no face, limbs or stone statue.

entries.name: Squeaky Hinge
entries.description: A large open butterfly hinge, two mismatched brass leaves and a long capped pin, hovering at a comic slant. It loudly requests silence, pulling out its own pin while somehow staying together. Intent idea: interrupt a prepared effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: leaves tremble. Tell: pin glows. Action: pin lifts; leaves clap once without contact. Resolve: pin drops back upside down.
entries.signature: Signature Flat double-winged hardware, not a complete door or a hand reaching from a wall.

entries.name: Vent Grille
entries.description: A short rectangular iron air grille with five broad louvers and a cobweb tied like a tiny bow in one corner. It holds its breath to avoid discovery, then sneezes out a perfectly square dust puff. Intent idea: briefly obscure, then expose itself.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: cobweb flutters inward. Tell: louvers pinch closed. Action: open in sequence; square puff escapes. Resolve: louvers straighten sheepishly.
entries.signature: Signature Low slatted rectangle and geometric dust; no humanoid drain shadow or vapor creature.

entries.name: The Silent Winch
entries.description: A broad wooden cable drum held between two iron cheeks, a large offset hand crank and one endless loop of pale rope disappearing into its own center. It draws up something that never arrives; one knotted bow passes again before the drum completes a turn. Intent idea: wind up a stronger effect that can be interrupted.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: crank inches backward. Tell: rope pulls taut. Action: one deliberate turn; duplicate bow passes along the loop. Resolve: crank releases a quarter-turn and rope relaxes. Use a short scrolling rope texture.
entries.signature: Signature Horizontal drum and closed rope circuit; not a plumb bob, cage, cart or open portal.

entries.name: The Skeleton Lock
entries.description: An oversized brass mortise lock seen in side cutaway, its rectangular backplate supporting three chunky tumblers and a large empty keyhole. The name refers only to a skeleton key; there are no bones. Its proud inner mechanism locks and unlocks itself without anyone asking; the keyhole slides to avoid a nonexistent key. Intent idea: alternate two clearly signaled restrictions.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tumblers tick. Tell: keyhole brightens. Action: three tumblers hop; keyhole plate slides sideways. Resolve: latch returns, keyhole slowly recenters. No door or room beyond it.
entries.signature: Signature Exposed lockwork, not another cabinet, barred gate or crowd of keys.

entries.name: The Folding Partition
entries.description: Three narrow plaster-and-lath panels joined by exposed vertical brass hinges. Their uneven tops and visible wooden ribs form a tall, crooked zigzag; no doorway is cut into them. They keep shortening an unused shortcut. A blue seam travels straight across all three panels even while they fold in opposite directions. Intent idea: temporary obstruction followed by an exposed opening.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: hinge dust trembles. Tell: seam brightens. Action: crossfade between open and concertina-folded poses while the seam stays level. Resolve: panels unfold with one embarrassed creak. Two fixed poses; no moving camera.
entries.signature: Signature Folding internal wall fabric, not a staircase, freestanding door, domestic screen or miniature room.

entries.name: The Man in the Walls
entries.description: A flat midnight-blue figure lives between two offset wallpaper strips. A long profile nose, soft hat and oversized mitten-like hands keep him recognizable and bashful; no stretched flesh or exposed anatomy. The mansion’s shy eavesdropper insists nobody saw him, even while his shadow waves hello. Intent idea: concealed preparation alternates with a visible interruption opportunity.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: peek around paper. Tell: strips ripple outward. Action: silhouette slides halfway out and gestures “shh.” Resolve: hand retracts; delayed shadow waves. One silhouette rig, two paper layers and one shadow; no room or camera changes.
entries.signature: Signature A wall-bound peekaboo performer, not a free-standing shadow guest or many-part architectural guardian.

entries.name: Towel Poltergeist
entries.description: Three thick square towels hover in a stepped stack; one embroidered corner makes their orientation unmistakable. A fussy folder forever correcting untidy corners; could temporarily tuck away one available option.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: bob. Tell: top corner lifts. Action: two hinged folds close. Resolve: stack squares itself.
entries.signature: Signature Compact folding geometry, not a sheet-bodied ghost or flowing blanket.

entries.name: Drain Shade
entries.description: A flat black silhouette peeks from an oversized oval drain plate, stopping at a rounded shoulder. Bashfully borrows things left near its hiding place; suggests briefly removing an active support effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: peek. Tell: grate tilts. Action: silhouette contracts through a fixed mask. Resolve: grate settles.
entries.signature: Signature A floor-bound disappearing cutout, never a reaching arm or full smoke person.

entries.name: Scrub Brush
entries.description: An oversized long-handled bath brush balances diagonally on its broad oval bristles, without face or limbs. Polishes away even perfectly useful marks; could erase a recently placed modifier.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: bristles flex. Tell: handle leans back. Action: short polishing arc. Resolve: single sparkle pops.
entries.signature: Signature Rigid diagonal lever and scrub rhythm, unlike floating utensil clusters.

entries.name: Soap-Dish Skater
entries.description: A broad scalloped dish carries one rectangular soap bar, which slides independently along its short rim. Keeps offering the soap just out of convenient reach; could shift which option becomes available first.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: bar rocks. Tell: dish tips. Action: bar slides end-to-end. Resolve: dish levels.
entries.signature: Signature Low crescent silhouette with one sliding block; neither blob nor soap creature.

entries.name: Tile Quartet
entries.description: Four large ceramic diamonds hover as one staggered cluster; raised ridges keep their pattern readable without color. An obsessive pattern-maker rerouting every sensible arrangement; suggests swapping two upcoming cues.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tiny staggered bob. Tell: tiles separate. Action: two exchange on fixed paths. Resolve: cluster clicks together.
entries.signature: Signature Four solid geometric pieces, not a wall section or portal.

entries.name: Rain Chain
entries.description: Three oversized copper rain cups hang from a short hooked chain, their open profiles stacked vertically. Politely returns the rain upstairs; could pass a small helpful effect backward through the opposing lineup.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: slight sway. Tell: bottom cup tips. Action: one bead hops upward. Resolve: cups straighten.
entries.signature: Signature Vertical cup-to-cup relay; no ringing, orbiting swarm, or free-flowing water.

entries.name: Bath Thermometer
entries.description: A paddle-shaped wooden bath thermometer floats upright; its broad inset column visibly expands and contracts. Never finds the room quite comfortable enough; could alternate between two clearly announced preparation states.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: gentle tilt. Tell: column grows. Action: paddle nods decisively. Resolve: column shrinks.
entries.signature: Signature One tall solid paddle and rising bar, not a spinning gauge or clock.

entries.name: The Grand Bath
entries.description: A deep claw-foot tub with a high curled back and three oversized bath bubbles held above its rim. The interior is a flat opaque ellipse, never a rendered pool. Insists every visitor deserves a leisurely soak; could postpone an opposing cue while building a generous protective buffer.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tub rocks. Tell: bubbles rise together. Action: three bubbles expand into a soft screen. Resolve: they pop in sequence; tub settles.
entries.signature: Signature Broad curled basin silhouette; no second walking-tub regular.

entries.name: The Breathing Radiator
entries.description: A squat cast-iron radiator with four broad scalloped fins and two huge loop feet. The fins move as one accordion strip; only two warm-air curls appear. A contented old warmer that sighs whenever anyone rushes; suggests a predictable comfort pulse that resets a minor nuisance on its side.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: slow fin compression. Tell: feet lift together. Action: two curls rise during a long sigh. Resolve: feet settle and fins relax.
entries.signature: Signature Horizontal ribbed silhouette, not the Lampworks' branching gas manifold.

entries.name: The Rain Collector
entries.description: An enormous flared rain funnel balances above one squat measuring jar on a narrow pedestal. Three embossed water-level bands are readable shapes, not tiny numerals. Proudly saves every imaginary shower, then returns it at the least convenient moment; could store a limited number of incoming nuisances before repeating them.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: funnel wobbles. Tell: jar's flat fill mask reaches its top band. Action: three beads rise through the funnel. Resolve: fill mask lowers.
entries.signature: Signature Top-heavy funnel silhouette and counted storage, not a fountain or storm creature.

entries.name: The Bathhouse Matron
entries.description: A welcoming spectral matron with a broad bell-shaped apron, puffed sleeves, high folded bath cap, and two floating towel squares. Her smiling profile stays simple; one fixed mask softens her hem. She remembers everybody's preferred comfort except when they wanted to leave. Her fussing could alternate between tidying away options and restoring helpers; a conspicuous satisfied pause suggests an interruption opportunity. She never confines or scalds anyone.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: approving nod. Tell: both towels lift. Action: open-palmed conducting gesture and one cropped steam puff. Resolve: towels rest; she waits expectantly.
entries.signature: Signature Rounded welcoming silhouette and deliberate pauses, not another severe key-bearing governess.

entries.name: Water Bowl Poltergeist
entries.description: A heavy oval bowl hovers above its broad rubber foot; one flat water ellipse rises intact. Offers a fresh drink during every important moment; could interrupt one cue with an unnecessary refresh.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tiny rock. Tell: ellipse lifts. Action: ellipse slides sideways like a coaster. Resolve: it returns.
entries.signature: Signature Low metal oval and impossible rigid water; no liquid creature.

entries.name: Grooming Mitt
entries.description: An empty padded grooming mitt floats thumb-up; three rubber nubs form a blunt scalloped edge. Cannot resist tidying one last speck of imaginary fluff; could brush away a small beneficial effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: thumb wiggles. Tell: palm tilts in-plane. Action: wiping sweep. Resolve: one fluff mote falls.
entries.signature: Signature Soft mitten silhouette, not a grasping spectral hand; never grips bodies.

entries.name: Reward Clicker
entries.description: A teardrop-shaped training clicker hovers vertically, its broad button and blunt metal tongue clearly separated. Congratulates everyone a beat too early; could prematurely trigger a helper's announced preparation.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tiny bounce. Tell: button rises. Action: button depresses and tongue flexes. Resolve: two fixed sound arcs fade.
entries.signature: Signature Solid teardrop and one crisp click, unlike dangling chimes.

entries.name: Fussing Fan
entries.description: A four-bladed grooming fan sits on a curved neck and triangular base; blades rotate in-plane. Keeps correcting a nonexistent bad hair day; could push a prepared nuisance back onto its owner.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: blades tick. Tell: neck leans. Action: blades accelerate with one airflow ribbon. Resolve: neck springs upright.
entries.signature: Signature Open pinwheel above a low base; no spotlight or watching eye.

entries.name: Treat Puzzle
entries.description: A thick wooden enrichment board holds three sliding covers, with one star-shaped treat visible beneath. Proudly changes the answer after explaining its puzzle; could conceal which of two cues is genuine.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: covers twitch. Tell: middle cover lifts slightly. Action: two covers slide. Resolve: treat peeks from one opening.
entries.signature: Signature Low rectangular slider puzzle, not a chest or food creature.

entries.name: Scent Tin
entries.description: A round scent-training tin floats on edge; its crescent lid exposes three large scent holes. Mistakes every visitor for a familiar fragrance; could mark a choice for an extra follow-up cue.
