entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: lid rattles. Tell: lid slides halfway. Action: one curled scent line traces a loop. Resolve: lid shuts.
entries.signature: Signature Thin disc profile; one drawn scent line, not smoke anatomy.

entries.name: Pace Cone
entries.description: A squat training cone balances on a square rubber base, bearing one raised paw-shaped badge. Moves the start of playtime whenever everyone is ready; could redirect the next cue toward a decoy.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tip wobbles. Tell: one corner lifts. Action: sideways hop. Resolve: base flattens.
entries.signature: Signature Single broad triangle and jaunty hop; no barrier or animal silhouette.

entries.name: The Tag Collector
entries.description: A broad zigzag display rail carries three oversized loose identity tags: round, bone-shaped, and diamond. Tags slide along short pegs; no collar, animal, or leash is attached. Delighted to remember everyone, but assigns the wrong places in line; could exchange two announced opposing cues.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tags sway. Tell: tags rise. Action: two trade positions on short paths. Resolve: all rehang with a pleased jingle.
entries.signature: Signature Wide zigzag and three contrasting shapes, not a coatrack or wall of names.

entries.name: The Fetch Return
entries.description: A broad U-shaped wooden ball-return track sits on stubby feet. One stitched fabric ball rests between its open raised ends; no animal occupies it. An indefatigable playmate believes every completed activity deserves another go; could recycle one resolved helper cue rather than introducing a new threat.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: ball rocks. Tell: track end tilts. Action: ball follows a fixed U-path. Resolve: opposite end bounces welcomingly.
entries.signature: Signature Open U silhouette and single rolling prop, not a toy chest swarm or room-sized course.

entries.name: The Portion Balance
entries.description: A wide feeding balance has a thick central post, two broad pans, and a sliding counterweight. Three treat tokens remain grouped as one reusable sprite. Generous to a fault, it keeps correcting unequal portions; could redistribute a limited protective benefit among helpers rather than generate more.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: beam teeters. Tell: counterweight slides. Action: treat cluster transfers between pans. Resolve: beam pauses emphatically horizontal.
entries.signature: Signature Wide balanced T silhouette and equalizing gesture; no examining, weighing, or restraining animals.

entries.name: The Kennelmaster
entries.description: A broad, calm spectral caretaker in a knee-length ward coat, with rolled sleeves, an oversized round treat pouch, and two simple playthings on his belt. His boots fade through one soft ground mask. Delighted by company, he has scheduled far too much play and fuss. Open gestures could coordinate grooming, reward, and play cues; a clear empty-handed pause offers a chance to break the routine. No animal is commanded to fight, confined, examined, or distressed.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: reassuring nod. Tell: lifts pouch. Action: one broad invitation coordinates helpers. Resolve: folds hands and waits.
entries.signature: Signature Square coat and circular pouch contrast with the Matron's bell-shaped apron and cap.

entries.name: Pumpkin Lantern
entries.description: A squat carved pumpkin hovering just above its curled stem-shadow, with a small, warmly lopsided smile. Winks an inviting patch of light onto the wrong place; suggests distracting the visitor from a fellow haunt's next cue.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: gentle bob. Tell: lid tilts. Action: one glow-mask expands from the carving. Resolve: lid settles and light contracts.
entries.signature: Signature A single floating invitation; never a walking pumpkin or miniature cart.

entries.name: Moon Dial
entries.description: A low, tilted stone dial with a crescent-shaped gnomon and three inset moon marks. Borrows a patch of moon-shadow for nearby haunts; suggests brief cover from the visitor, not another clock's time reversal.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: faint glyph shimmer. Tell: crescent tips sideways. Action: a small shadow wedge sweeps outward. Resolve: crescent and shadow return.
entries.signature: Signature Low stone profile and redirected shade, not spinning celestial machinery.

entries.name: Hay Bale Poltergeist
entries.description: A compact rectangular hay bale with two conspicuously tidy twine bands and no face or limbs. Reties its own packing whenever disturbed; suggests rebuilding a small protective layer rather than lunging at anyone.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tiny straw shiver. Tell: bands loosen. Action: bands tighten while three straw flecks return. Resolve: bale gives a satisfied settling bounce.
entries.signature: Signature A self-packing block, not a straw person or blanket creature.

entries.name: Harvest Sieve
entries.description: A broad wooden sieve suspended at a readable slant, its mesh holding three oversized golden seeds. Sifts upward, keeping the festival's 'best bits'; suggests removing a nuisance from a fellow haunt.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: shallow rocking. Tell: seeds gather centrally. Action: mesh flashes and three flecks rise. Resolve: seeds settle into their original positions.
entries.signature: Signature One shallow mesh oval; the supernatural act is reverse sifting.

entries.name: Prize Rosette
entries.description: An oversized pleated prize ribbon floating upright, with a bright blank center and two short tails. Insists a nearby nuisance deserves first prize; suggests briefly bolstering one fellow haunt while drawing the visitor's attention.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: tails flutter. Tell: pleats open slightly. Action: center flashes one star-shaped seal. Resolve: pleats close and tails fall still.
entries.signature: Signature A compact award badge, not a mask, ghost guest or streamer swarm.

entries.name: Seed Scoop
entries.description: A long-handled wooden measure balanced impossibly on its narrow tip, holding one pale, oversized seed. Plants its one seed in empty air, convinced spring is here; suggests a small, visibly announced buildup.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: careful balancing. Tell: bowl inclines. Action: seed lifts above one faint root-shaped glow. Resolve: glow fades and seed returns.
entries.signature: Signature A narrow leverlike silhouette planting air, not another portion-balancing scale.

entries.name: Seed Rattle
entries.description: A ridged tin seed shaker with a short handle, a tied ribbon, and no opening mouth. Shakes the festival's count-in before anyone is ready; suggests nudging the rhythm of an announced effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: ribbon droops. Tell: handle rises. Action: two crisp shakes release tiny sound rings. Resolve: shaker tilts back and ribbon settles.
entries.signature: Signature A closed upright cylinder; sound cues distinguish it from dispensing tools.

entries.name: The Great Pumpkin Cart
entries.description: A broad two-wheeled harvest wagon with three clearly separated gourds, one shallow basket and a curved wooden rail. No face, arms or giant glowing pumpkin dominates it. Re-sorts the harvest into an order it considers perfect; suggests exchanging which fellow haunt receives the next protective effect.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: wheel rocks a fraction. Tell: basket tips. Action: three attached gourds lift and exchange preset slots. Resolve: basket levels and gourds settle with staggered bounces.
entries.signature: Signature Horizontal inventory choreography, not the regular lantern's floating light invitation.

entries.name: The Cider Press
entries.description: A squat slatted cider barrel beneath one tall screw and a broad T-handle. Its little collecting cup stays visibly attached to the base; no surrounding workshop is needed. Patiently presses the same impossible drop twice, saving a second serving for a fellow haunt; suggests banking enemy-side recovery.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: handle sways. Tell: screw descends one short increment. Action: one amber drop enters the cup, then rises back. Resolve: screw unwinds and the cup's glow remains briefly.
entries.signature: Signature Vertical rotary compression, unlike the crypt's squat lever-and-stamp press.

entries.name: The Generous Cornucopia
entries.description: A large curled wicker horn resting on its side, with three fixed harvest shapes near the rim and one loose ribbon at its narrow tip. Offers fellow haunts another helping from its empty basket; suggests renewing their spent blessings without spawning food creatures.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: wicker gently flexes. Tell: rim tips up. Action: three flat golden offering-shapes follow the same short arc outward and fade. Resolve: rim lowers and the ribbon unwinds.
entries.signature: Signature An unmistakable curved horn whose excess is hospitality, not appetite.

entries.name: The Harvest Effigy
entries.description: A grand festival figure built from straw, wooden crossbars and broad fan-shaped sleeves. A plain wooden moon mask replaces a conventional face; small pumpkins, ribbons and two unlit lantern ornaments decorate its waist. Keep the whole silhouette fixed and puppetlike. Conducts one last harvest welcome, awarding its fellow haunts the brightest patch of moonlight. It suggests ceremonial enemy-side protection followed by generous, readable openings, rather than striking or frightening the visitor.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: shallow crossbar sway. Tell: sleeve lifts and mask inclines. Action: both sleeves fan outward as three ribbon accents trace a short welcoming arc. Resolve: sleeves fold, ornaments settle and mask bows.
entries.signature: Signature The region's only scarecrow-shaped presence; no lesser effigy repeats its silhouette.

entries.name: Nameplate
entries.description: One broad horizontal brass plaque, its oversized engraved letter-shapes softly luminous and deliberately unreadable at sprite scale. Insists the visitor has arrived under the wrong name; suggests briefly muddling a choice through mistaken identity, not transferring roles.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: slight hover. Tell: letters brighten separately. Action: three letter layers swap into a new order. Resolve: brass catches one insistent glint.
entries.signature: Signature One mistaken household label, not the animal ward's tag-swapping display.

entries.name: House Pulse
entries.description: A palm-sized open knot of bent wood, copper wire and folded wallpaper surrounding a steady blue glow. Steadies the other haunts just as the visitor gains momentum; suggests modest enemy-side recovery with a conspicuous, interruptible pulse.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: slow contraction. Tell: glow gathers centrally. Action: one soft ring expands while three outer pieces separate slightly. Resolve: pieces return and glow steadies.
entries.signature: Signature Compact abstract heartbeat, never a transforming version of The Keeper.

entries.name: Welcome Cushion
entries.description: A single plump wedge-shaped cushion with piped edges and one button; an invisible elbow occasionally dimples it. Fluffs itself at the visitor's busiest moment, insisting it is time to rest; suggests a brief, clearly signaled timing nuisance.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: button sinks gently. Tell: corners rise. Action: cushion compresses and releases one small puff. Resolve: elbow dimple returns.
entries.signature: Signature One soft wedge, with no chair, bed, face or blanket swarm.

entries.name: Darning Hoop
entries.description: A suspended wooden embroidery hoop displaying a simple stitched house; one blunt needle remains tethered to the fabric. Mends a tiny gap in its embroidered home; suggests restoring a fellow haunt's protection just when the visitor has loosened it.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: loose thread sways. Tell: a stitch glows. Action: needle crosses one short seam and thread tightens. Resolve: repaired stitch dims.
entries.signature: Signature A fixed circular craft frame; the needle never points toward a character.

entries.name: Draft Stopper
entries.description: A long, plain stuffed fabric cylinder with square end tabs, resting low against the floor without animal features. Scoots toward any troublesome breeze; suggests damping a passing effect rather than grabbing or restraining anyone.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: one end lifts. Tell: fabric bunches centrally. Action: two segments compress and slide a short distance. Resolve: cylinder straightens.
entries.signature: Signature A practical low fabric bar, never a snake or reaching blanket.

entries.name: Plumb Bob
entries.description: A polished brass teardrop on one taut thread, suspended beside a tiny bracket without a larger wall panel. Corrects a visitor's carefully altered intention because the house considers it crooked; suggests restoring an enemy cue to its usual direction.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: slight pendulum swing. Tell: thread holds an impossible diagonal. Action: bob snaps gently upright with one glint. Resolve: a smaller swing resumes.
entries.signature: Signature One hanging teardrop; no pulley machinery, clockwork or viewing aperture.

entries.name: Floorboard Knocker
entries.description: A short freestanding oak floorboard, slightly bowed, with a worn knot and two rounded nail heads. Answers hurried footsteps with a reassuring double knock; suggests a clearly announced interruption rather than a physical trip.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: one edge flexes. Tell: board arches. Action: its ends tap twice, each releasing a small sound ring. Resolve: board lies flat.
entries.signature: Signature A low rigid plank whose voice is a knock, not a shadow occupant.

entries.name: The Keeper's Hands
entries.description: Two oversized white-gloved hands joined by a short, soft blue shadow-ribbon. Their open palms and rounded fingers read as helpful household gestures, with no arms emerging from doorways. Smooths an invisible wrinkle, then politely presents the newly tidy space; suggests rearranging fellow haunts' protection without holding or trapping the visitor.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: fingers relax. Tell: palms turn upward. Action: hands make one synchronized smoothing pass across their own ribbon. Resolve: fingers open and return to their original spread.
entries.signature: Signature Paired palm gestures, not the Ward's equipment or a grasping single hand.

entries.name: The Inner Stair
entries.description: Four broad wooden steps on one visible diagonal support, with a curled banister end and warm light beneath each tread. No doors, walking figures or miniature rooms appear. Offers a fellow haunt the same comfortable next step twice; suggests repeating its small nuisance while delaying the visitor's hurried sequence.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: under-step lights breathe. Tell: top tread lifts. Action: four tread layers rise sequentially, making one compact traveling ripple. Resolve: layers reseat from bottom to top.
entries.signature: Signature A fixed stair silhouette with four offsets, never an unfolding maze.

entries.name: The Waiting Hearth
entries.description: A compact, low fireplace with a broad mantel and three amber embers hovering above an empty grate. Rounded stonework and a folded hearth cloth make it welcoming rather than furnace-like. Keeps warmth ready for fellow haunts, even when the visitor would prefer their routine to finish; suggests storing enemy-side comfort for later.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: embers bob. Tell: mantel glow gathers inward. Action: three embers align briefly above the grate and release one warm halo. Resolve: halo fades and embers spread.
entries.signature: Signature A stationary promise of welcome, not another boiler, lamp or burning creature.

entries.name: The Keeper
entries.description: A low, broad guardian assembled from banister beams, padded upholstery, closed decorative door panels and a quilted mantle. Two warm window-eyes sit beneath a roof-ridge brow; blue light glows through the seams. Its comforting shape stays fixed throughout the encounter. The mansion shelters its own haunts too insistently, then learns to respect its guest's pace. It suggests enemy-side shelter phases followed by clear openings, never imprisonment or a predatory attack.
entries.animation: 2D animation Idle: torso breathes. Tell: brow lowers and mantle lifts. Action: one padded forelimb extends while a short quilt awning opens over its own body. Resolve: awning folds and the guardian steps back slightly.
entries.signature: Signature A soft architectural guardian, not a humanoid servant, transforming collage or simulated room.
